Paragraph: In Bhagavad Gita Chapter 4, Verse 38, Krishna reassures Arjuna: 'In this world, there is nothing so purifying as spiritual knowledge. One who has attained mastery through Yoga enjoys this wisdom within oneself in due course of time.'
Situation/Problem_Faced: Confusion, cognitive distortion, and lack of self-worth resolved through learning and wisdom.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna highlights self-knowledge (Jnana) as the ultimate mental purifier, encouraging consistent spiritual and reflective practice.
Outcome/Resolution: Acquiring true wisdom resolves internal confusion, bringing mental clarity and self-worth.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Self-knowledge clears ignorance and doubt, revealing the innate purity of the self.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Emphasizes psychoeducation, self-reflection, and cognitive reframing as tools for mental wellness.
